scope: Original public runtime and synthetic regression suite; private native drawings and evidence excluded.

publicTestAdaptations.core.test.mjs: Native evidence/helper and archived-sample-dependent test expressions removed individually; remaining synthetic bodies preserved. Pure sequence labels identify synthetic cases.
publicTestAdaptations.dwg-import.test.mjs: Native/historical sample-dependent cases removed; synthetic decoder bodies preserved.
publicTestAdaptations.units-v15.cjs, layouts-v16.cjs, viewport: Require local pinned Playwright, without personal cache paths.
publicTestAdaptations.desktop-unit.test.cjs: Outside-app fixture is a sibling of repository root, independent of workspace layout.
publicTestAdaptations.run-layout-pdf-v16.cjs, run-viewport-pdf: Use local pinned Electron without private cache lookup.
publicTestAdaptations.export-viewport-scales-sample.mjs: The same original sample generator places its optional audited PDF under ignored work; source includes only the editable Linecraft sample.
publicTestAdaptations.audit-viewport-dxf-v17.py: Optional independent reader cache stays under the cloned repository work directory.
publicTestAdaptations.architecture-desktop.cjs, dev-reload.cjs: Require the local pinned Playwright dependency instead of a personal runtime-cache fallback.
publicTestAdaptations.samples/viewport-v17-reference.linecraft: Regenerated original synthetic fixture under 1.9 adds architecture:null to its Linecraft/1 document; geometry and layouts are unchanged.
publicTestAdaptations.clearance-desktop.cjs: Require the local pinned Playwright dependency instead of a personal runtime-cache fallback.
publicTestAdaptations.units-v15.cjs, layouts-v16.cjs, viewport: Use the corrected source fixtures: real native resize plus explicit CSS viewport sizing, avoiding Windows DPI rounding. Keep all exact-size and no-overflow assertions. Require local pinned Playwright without personal cache paths.
publicTestAdaptations.samples/roof-space-H-v19.linecraft: Retained original schema 1 bytes as a migration fixture; the updated exporter verifies the canonical archived file before migration.
publicTestAdaptations.tray-desktop.cjs: Require the local pinned Playwright dependency without a personal runtime-cache fallback. Preserve every hidden-window, layout and exact fixed-roof assertion.
publicTestAdaptations.samples/ceiling-space-v110.linecraft: Retain original schema 2 bytes as a migration fixture; publish schema 3 tray source as a separate example.

exclusions: Native drawings, scripts, exported references, observed JSON, images, evidence and command corpora
Current/historical reports, screenshots, logs, registry/install metadata and private paths
Internal release driver/manifest/documentation; node_modules, build outputs and standalone bundle

publicDocumentationAdaptations.docs/roof-space/IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.m: Owner-provided implementation specification, with prepared-for personal name omitted and client drawing warning generalized. The independently supplied synthetic fixture and technical requirements are retained.
